name: xoreos
description:
xoreos is an open-source reimplementation of BioWare's Aurora engine and its successors. The goal is to provide a unified, native open-source engine to play classic Western RPGs on modern platforms.

Features:
- Supports Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic I and II
- Compatible with Neverwinter Nights, Jade Empire, and Dragon Age: Origins
- Modernized OpenGL graphics rendering with high-resolution support
- Native cross-platform execution eliminating legacy DirectX and OS compatibility issues
- Requires original game installation data files to play
